description.en: Jimaodanus-inspired preserved algal axis fragment only, with lower branched hairlike whorls in a fine secondary branching tier and an upper subapical crown of thicker simple unbranched clavate laterals. Two distinct branch types, not duplicated branches with changed density. Historical Heterocladus name retained as nomenclatural context only; no roots, unknown mother thallus or complete living plant claim.
description.zh: Jimaodanus启发保存藻轴片段，下部细刷轮枝具次级分叉，上部近顶冠为较粗未分叉棒瓣，两区枝型与粗细阶次不同，非同枝改密度。历史Heterocladus名仅作命名背景，不添根、未知母藻或完整活体植物。

structural_scope.en: Preserved algal axis fragment only. Lower fine hairlike whorls have a secondary branching tier; upper subapical clavate laterals are thicker and unbranched. Historical Heterocladus name is context only. No roots, unknown tall stalk or whole living mother plant.
